description: Shell script that sets up and runs performance tests for writing a cache or index in a git repository, utilizing external testing functions and configuration.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Sets up a default git repository for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a success check with an accompanying description, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: test_tool write-cache
methods.description: Executes the cache writing performance test command.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
